answered.sql: SELECT T3.source_value FROM Affordable_Housing_Projects_Financing_Sources AS T1 JOIN Affordable_Housing_Projects AS T2 ON T1.housing_project_id = T2.project_id JOIN Financing_Sources AS T3 ON T1.financing_source_id = T3.source_id GROUP BY T3.source_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.project_id) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT project_id) FROM Affordable_Housing_Projects)

candidates.meaning: For each affordable housing project, show the source value of each financing source.
candidates.sql: SELECT ahp.project_name, fs.source_value FROM Affordable_Housing_Projects AS ahp JOIN Affordable_Housing_Projects_Financing_Sources AS ahfps ON ahp.project_id = ahfps.housing_project_id JOIN Financing_Sources AS fs ON ahfps.financing_source_id = fs.source_id

candidates.meaning: Retrieve the source value of financing sources for each affordable housing project.
candidates.sql: SELECT ahp.project_name, fs.source_value FROM Affordable_Housing_Projects AS ahp JOIN Affordable_Housing_Projects_Financing_Sources AS ahfps ON ahp.project_id = ahfps.housing_project_id JOIN Financing_Sources AS fs ON ahfps.financing_source_id = fs.source_id

candidates.meaning: List the project name and the corresponding financing source values for each project, including multiple sources if applicable.
candidates.sql: SELECT ahp.project_name, GROUP_CONCAT(fs.source_value) AS financing_sources FROM Affordable_Housing_Projects AS ahp JOIN Affordable_Housing_Projects_Financing_Sources AS ahfps ON ahp.project_id = ahfps.housing_project_id JOIN Financing_Sources AS fs ON ahfps.financing_source_id = fs.source_id GROUP BY ahp.project_name

candidates.meaning: Identify the primary financing source value for each affordable housing project.
candidates.sql: SELECT ahp.project_name, fs.source_value FROM Affordable_Housing_Projects AS ahp JOIN Affordable_Housing_Projects_Financing_Sources AS ahfps ON ahp.project_id = ahfps.housing_project_id JOIN Financing_Sources AS fs ON ahfps.financing_source_id = fs.source_id WHERE ahfps.id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM Affordable_Housing_Projects_Financing_Sources WHERE housing_project_id = ahp.project_id)
